Controller (d/f/m)
Workload: 100%
Location: Losone
Job type: Unlimited
Your tasks
- Overall responsibility for the Finance, Administration, and Logistics functions, including ensuring compliance with
internal policies, regulatory requirements, and internal control systems
- Lead and coordinate monthly, quarterly, and annual closing activities, including both statutory and group reporting
requirements
- Take ownership of forecasting, budgeting, financial analysis, and management reporting processes
- Analyze business performance, identify optimization opportunities, and provide proactive support in strategic and
operational decision-making
- Drive improvements in profitability, cash flow, and working capital management, while leading process optimization
initiatives and SAP-related projects
Your profile
- University degree in Finance, Accounting, Business Administration, or a related field
- Minimum of 10 years of professional experience in Controlling and Financial Management.
- Strong expertise in IFRS accounting standards, as well as proven experience in group reporting and consolidation
processes
- Advanced proficiency in SAP or comparable ERP systems, combined with excellent Excel skills.
- Fluent in German and English, with strong verbal and written communication skills
- Analytical, structured, and solution-oriented professional with a strong commercial mindset and entrepreneurial
approach.
- Demonstrated experience in leading, developing, and coaching teams, coupled with excellent communication and
stakeholder management skills
UNITED MACHINING is one of the world's leading providers of complete solutions for precision components and tools
manufacturers and the mold-making industry. The portfolio includes milling, EDM, laser texturing, laser micromachining,
and additive manufacturing machines.

learning tools as well as trainings and specialized courses.

sustainable future together.
